author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹಸಿವನೀಗಲು ನಿತ್ಯ ಜೀವನದೆ ಹೋರಾಟ
ಬಸಿರಿಂದ ಚಿತೆವರೆಗು ರಂಗಮಂಚದ ಬದುಕು
ತುಸುಕುಸಿಯೆ ಆತಂಕ ಬಣ್ಣಬಣ್ಣದ ವೇಷ
ಮುಸುಕಿನಲೆ ಗುದ್ದಾಟ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: To still hunger, life is a daily struggle;
from womb to pyre, life is a stage;
if you falter a little, anxiety; many-coloured costumes;
a fist-fight under a veil, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Life from womb to pyre is a play acted out to feed ourselves. Behind the colourful costumes, with anxiety at every stumble, is a hidden, daily struggle.
